cases.question: Những mã hàng nào có mức đáp ứng kém nhất ở kỳ tồn kho mới nhất? Lấy 10 sản phẩm.

result.sql: SELECT i.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date, i.product_id AS product_id, p.product_name AS product_name, i.fill_rate AS stored_fill_rate FROM commerce.inventory AS i JOIN commerce.products AS p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(j.snapshot_date) FROM commerce.inventory AS j) ORDER BY 4 ASC, 2 ASC LIMIT 10

stored_fill_rate.name: Stored product fill rate
stored_fill_rate.description: Recorded product-level value; do not infer its original formula or treat it as an aggregate fulfillment rate.

stored_fill_rate.temporal_semantics: One selected snapshot or separate exact snapshot_date groups; never combine balances across dates.
stored_fill_rate.null_handling: Non-null stored values only; SUM and AVG of no observations remain NULL; COUNT is zero; absent snapshots are not zero stock.
stored_fill_rate.zero_denominator: Return NULL using NULLIF; never substitute zero for an undefined ratio.

limitations: Historical monthly observations; every answer must state the selected snapshot date.
Missing product snapshots are not zero inventory; denominators cover observed products only.
No live warehouse balance, purchase-order, backorder, forecast or supplier lead-time evidence.
Stored rate values are returned unchanged as fractions; 0.25 displays as 25 percent, without implying the original source formula.

Interpret the question BEFORE generating SQL. Return one JSON object, no Markdown, SQL, formulas or new metric IDs.
Map English, Vietnamese and mixed language, synonyms and paraphrases onto inventory catalog IDs. Use domain=other only for requests entirely outside inventory analytics (e.g. list products, orders, payments). Never use other to evade an unsupported inventory metric. If unclear, return only {"clarification":"specific question"}. Low stock without a numeric threshold or explicit top/bottom ranking is ambiguous. Do not invent thresholds, weights, forecasts or reorder rules. Unresolved IDs must remain unresolved; never substitute a different metric. For product-level rankings use representation=product and product_name/product_id dimensions. For category totals use aggregate and category. Stored fill rankings use stored_fill_rate; means use fill_rate. Filters apply to source rows, not computed aggregates. Date ranges are inclusive. Require a requested historical date/range/history or explicit latest AVAILABLE snapshot; do not silently turn today/current stock into historical latest. Do not omit any requested filter, metric, dimension, ranking or time constraint. Snapshot date is always included automatically. Preserve supplied filter values; translate field concepts, not product codes or category names.
Allowed dimensions: snapshot_date, product_id, product_name, category, segment, size, color. Filters: these dimensions except snapshot_date, or recorded scalar inventory metric IDs.

Generate one read-only PostgreSQL SELECT for the user question. Use only the tables, columns, and join keys below. Write each table as commerce.<table> AS <short_alias> and refer to its columns only as <alias>.<column>; never use commerce.<table>.<column> or unqualified columns. Use PostgreSQL functions only from this validator-approved list: ABS, AVG, CAST, CEIL, COALESCE, COUNT, DATE_PART, DATE_TRUNC, EXTRACT, FLOOR, GREATEST, LEAST, LOWER, MAX, MIN, NULLIF, OR, ROUND, STRING_AGG, SUM, TIMESTAMP_TRUNC, UPPER. Bind each user-provided filter value with $1, $2, ... and include exactly one corresponding value in the JSON parameters array for every placeholder; never emit an unbound placeholder or an unused parameter. Use ORDER BY positions (such as ORDER BY 1) and LIMIT at most 200 in the final SELECT. Return clarification only if the requested data is ambiguous. Return only JSON: {"sql": string, "parameters": array, "explanation": string} or {"clarification": string}. Never use writes, comments, or multiple statements.
Use the canonical formula, sources, grain, dimensions and required filters for each recognized metric. Do not invent a metric definition or substitute a different measure. Ask for clarification if the requested definition or dimension conflicts with the ontology. Preserve unknown currency; do not assume USD or VND. CAST is permitted only to DATE or NUMERIC. Ratio formulas return fractions even when the unit is percent; do not silently multiply them by 100. When no metric is recognized, ordinary read-only queries are still permitted.
Joins must preserve each aggregate's source grain: many-to-one dimension joins are safe; do not sum or average parent measures after joining multiple detail rows. Remove unnecessary detail joins; use COUNT(DISTINCT entity_key) for entity counts. SUM(DISTINCT value) is not a fix.
Inventory Management requirements:
Every result MUST include i.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date. For aggregates, GROUP BY i.snapshot_date and every other dimension. The final SELECT MUST have LIMIT 1..200, using the requested ranking limit or otherwise 200, including repairs.
Example for latest total stock: SELECT i.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date, SUM(i.stock_on_hand) AS stock_on_hand FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(j.snapshot_date) FROM commerce.inventory AS j) GROUP BY i.snapshot_date LIMIT 200
For category results JOIN commerce.products AS p ON i.product_id = p.product_id and select/group p.category. Never use i.category, i.year or i.month; use the approved product attributes and snapshot_date. For a requested year use i.snapshot_date >= $1 AND i.snapshot_date < $2, binding January 1 of that year and January 1 of the next year.
products.product_id is a primary key; the inventory-to-products join is many-to-one. Flag ratios count i.product_id in both numerator and denominator so their source grain remains explicit. Never replace these counts with COUNT(*).
aggregation=value selects the stored product field without AVG or SUM; scalar_formula is only for ungrouped product rows. Means are explicitly unweighted. Do not invent source formulas or demand weights. Keep exact snapshot_date groups for trends; never sum balances across dates or invent zero for an absent product.
Latest means the unfiltered MAX(snapshot_date) from commerce.inventory, never a guessed date. Historical flags do not authorize reorders. Team acceptance and validation do not imply official business approval. Unresolved/unreviewed metrics cannot execute.

Question:
Những mã hàng nào có mức đáp ứng kém nhất ở kỳ tồn kho mới nhất? Lấy 10 sản phẩm.
Stored projection fields: {"stored_fill_rate": "fill_rate"}. Select these directly from the inventory alias. Do not aggregate or GROUP BY in product representation. Product identity may use inventory.product_id or the joined products.product_id.

Validated interpretation: {"domain": "inventory", "metrics": ["stored_fill_rate"], "dimensions": ["product_id", "product_name"], "filters": [], "time": {"mode": "latest", "start": null, "end": null}, "ranking": {"metric": "stored_fill_rate", "direction": "asc", "limit": 10}, "representation": "product", "clarification": null}
Preserve exactly these metrics, dimensions, source-row filters, date scope, output grain and ranking. Project snapshot_date plus only the requested dimensions and metrics. Product representation uses stored scalar values. Use GROUP BY qualified columns, ORDER BY positions, direct SELECT without CTE/HAVING/DISTINCT. Use the declared ranking limit, otherwise LIMIT 200. For an inclusive date range use snapshot_date >= start AND snapshot_date < the day AFTER end. For latest use the unfiltered MAX subquery. Filters use field <operator> parameter (IN uses a list of parameters); do not add other restrictions.
